To fix it, open the thermostat’s menu, select Holiday, and enter the date and time when you next expect to arrive. Choose your holiday temperature, then select Save. Check that the display shows both your return date and that holiday mode is active before leaving.

If your plans change, update the return date rather than switching the thermostat off. Keep the heating system powered so it can maintain your chosen temperature while the property is empty.

Replacing a cracked drain tray

For the Halvard Home Orrin heat pump, KX-1270 is the replacement condensate drain tray. This tray collects water and directs it into the drain hose. A crack can let water leak underneath the unit instead.

items.revised:
Burning smell from your Orrin heat pump

On the Halvard Home Orrin heat pump, E-1274 means the outdoor fan motor has overheated, potentially scorching its electrical insulation and causing a burning smell.

Stop using the heat pump immediately. If there is no smoke or fire and it is safe to approach, switch it off at the controller, then disconnect its power using the labelled isolation switch. Switching off at the controller alone does not isolate the electricity.

Do not restart the unit, remove its covers or attempt repairs. Contact Halvard Home support to arrange an inspection by a qualified engineer, and describe when the smell started.

If you see smoke or flames, keep away, leave the property and call 999. Do not use water on the appliance.

Brio kettle: first installation

Before using your Brio kettle, remove all packaging and place the power base on a dry, level worktop.

During first installation, E-6419 means the kettle is not seated correctly on its base. A protective packing insert left beneath the kettle can cause this fault.

To fix it, switch off the socket and unplug the base. Lift off the kettle, remove any remaining packing material and check that both contact surfaces are dry. Put the kettle squarely back on the base, then reconnect the power.

Rinse the kettle, fill it to the MAX mark with fresh cold water, boil once and discard the water before making drinks.

If the warning returns, unplug the kettle and contact Halvard Home support.

Water leaking underneath your Lumen thermostat

Water beneath your Lumen smart thermostat can be caused by a split cable-entry seal. This lets warm, damp air reach the cold wall behind the thermostat, where moisture forms and drips from the lower edge.

KX-7426 is the replacement cable-entry seal for this product, not an error message.

- Do not touch the thermostat while it is wet.
- Switch off the heating controls at their electrical isolator, provided the switch and surrounding area are dry.
- Contact Halvard Home support or a qualified heating engineer to inspect the seal and replace it if damaged.

Ask the engineer to check for nearby pipe leaks too. Do not restore power until the thermostat has been checked and declared safe.

Tessa dishwasher: flashing warning light

On your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher, a flashing warning light with E-4021 means water has not drained within five minutes. A blocked drain filter is the most common cause.

Stop the programme and switch the dishwasher off at the mains. If the water is hot, let it cool before opening the door fully. Place towels around the base to catch any spills.

Remove the bottom basket, then turn the filter anticlockwise and lift it out. Rinse it under warm running water, removing food scraps with a soft brush. Refit the filter securely before restoring power.

Run a rinse programme. If the warning returns or water remains inside, stop using the dishwasher and contact Halvard Home support.

items.revised:
Cleaning the Tessa dishwasher filter

Food trapped in the filter can cause water to pool at the bottom of your Tessa dishwasher after a wash.

KX-8645 is the part number for this dishwasher’s removable filter. Clean it twice a week to help prevent blockages.

Rinse the filter under warm running water, using a soft brush to remove food and grease. Avoid wire brushes, which can damage the mesh.
